recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the storage-range change on the active ModelInfo publication surface without taking over unrelated BDP model drift; remaining BDP ModelInfo mismatches should be handled by their own Jira evidence trail.
issue_request: FHIR-33033 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested changing BiologicallyDerivedProduct.storage.temperature from decimal to a range while removing the .scale attribute.
initial_application: The primary BiologicallyDerivedProduct StructureDefinition and examples were already updated through the broader BDP replacement in commit a261b7c6662ea3b212f0c8e20c83c3ada67cbee1, committed under FHIR-33068, which removed the old storage backbone and added storageTempRequirements as Range. No separate commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-33033 was found.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, and the FHIR ModelInfo sidecar is an active Library example/publication surface through source/library/library-examples-header.xml and publish.ini. That ModelInfo surface still carried the old storage backbone, decimal temperature, and BiologicallyDerivedProductStorageScale helper/type despite the authoritative resource source being correct. FHIR-33068 is same-change-family context and already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to expose storageTempRequirements as FHIR.Range, removed the obsolete BiologicallyDerivedProduct.Storage and BiologicallyDerivedProductStorageScale model/conversion entries, removed the matching FHIRHelpers ToString overload, and refreshed embedded Library payloads in the wrapper resources.

source/library/library-fhir-helpers-content.cql: removed the obsolete BiologicallyDerivedProductStorageScale ToString overload.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: refreshed embedded base64 content to match the updated ModelInfo sidecar.
